# Sensor budget (generated by `uv run python budget.py`)

p90 of |error|: inches for lengths, percent for scales. Optimistic and conservative put every
parameter at that end; the range column draws them uniformly between. Verdict rule (fixed before
the run): worth a device test if conservative p90 ≤ 2 in or ≤ 1%; drop if optimistic p90 > 4 in or > 3%.

## Parameters

| Name | Optimistic | Conservative | Unit | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `standoff_m` | 2.5 | 2.5 | m | app guidance: stand 1 to 3 m from the wall (docs/00) |
| `f_px` | 1450 | 1450 | px | wide camera focal length at 1920 px, typical ARKit capturedImage intrinsics |
| `dual_f_px` | 500 | 400 | px | depth map about 640 px wide: the 1450 px focal length scaled down (assumed) |
| `dual_baseline_m` | 0.02 | 0.012 | m | wide to ultra-wide spacing, assumed; the idea lab estimated 1.5 to 2 cm; no Apple spec |
| `dual_disp_px` | 0.1 | 0.5 | px | disparity noise, assumed; sub-pixel stereo range |
| `focal_mm` | 6.9 | 5.7 | mm | iPhone main camera focal lengths, 13 to 15 Pro (Apple tech specs) |
| `lens_pos_um` | 1 | 3 | um | lens position repeatability including heat and gravity sag, assumed; AVCaptureDevice.lensPosition is not calibrated to distance |
| `baro_pa` | 1 | 6 | Pa | relative pressure noise plus wind gusts; 1 Pa is a quiet sensor, 6 Pa a 3 m/s gust's dynamic pressure (assumed) |
| `rho_g` | 12 | 11.5 | Pa/m | air density times g near sea level |
| `uwb_sigma_m` | 0.05 | 0.2 | m | arXiv 2303.11220: errors under 20 cm in tested conditions; 5 cm assumed line of sight |
| `uwb_span_ft` | 20 | 20 | ft | operating distance along the wall |
| `tap_sigma_mm` | 1.5 | 4 | mm | finger landing spread, assumed; Apple's HIG minimum target is 44 pt (about 7 mm) |
| `screen_px_per_mm` | 12.4 | 12.4 | px/mm | iPhone 15 aspect-fill: 1920 px on 852 pt, 5.5 pt/mm, so 2.25 image px per pt |
| `snap_px` | 0.5 | 2 | px | sub-pixel edge localization: Steger reports under 0.1 px on clean edges; 2 px allows for texture |
| `anchor_yaw_deg` | 2.15 | 6.72 | deg | added after the run: median and p90 yaw of a 0.3 m depth-patch plane on ETH3D electro (experiments/edge-geometry), a proxy for one ARKit raycast normal; the first run assumed 1 to 5 |
| `tap_view_deg` | 35 | 35 | deg | view angle off face-on for an edge 5 ft from the meter tapped from 7 ft out |
| `tap_span_ft` | 6 | 6 | ft | edge distance from the meter |
| `span_ft` | 6 | 6 | ft | a window or gas meter 6 ft from the meter |
| `one_photo_standoff_m` | 3 | 3 | m | step back so both ends fit in a landscape frame |
| `lidar_scale` | 0.004 | 0.01 | fraction | iPhone LiDAR range error, about 1 cm at 3 m (assumed from Measure-style apps); 1% conservative |
| `vio_scale` | 0.01 | 0.03 | fraction | MARViN: 30 of 35 iPhone 14 Pro Max walks within 2% (evals section 6); 3% for a phone without LiDAR, assumed |
| `wall_yaw_lidar_deg` | 0.2 | 0.5 | deg | plane fitted to thousands of LiDAR points, assumed |
| `wall_yaw_vio_deg` | 0.5 | 2 | deg | plane from feature points or vanishing lines, assumed |
| `meter_cover_unknown_maker` | 0.029 | 0.029 | fraction | covers span 6.29 to 6.95 in across Itron, Aclara, Elster (maker drawings): ±5% uniform |
| `meter_cover_known_maker` | 0.003 | 0.01 | fraction | one maker's drawing, assumed moulding tolerance |
| `brick_course` | 0.005 | 0.016 | fraction | 3 courses = 8 in (BIA 9A); a mason's story pole holds coursing, 1/8 in per 8 in taken as the conservative end |
| `door_slab` | 0.006 | 0.013 | fraction | exterior slab 79.5 in, opening 80 in: which edge the photo shows is 0.5 to 1 in (Mastercraft) |
| `letter_sheet` | 0.003 | 0.006 | fraction | 11 in sheet; cut tolerance unknown, assumed 1/32 to 1/16 in |
| `id1_card` | 0.002 | 0.006 | fraction | ISO 7810 85.60 mm, new cards 85.47 to 85.72 (±0.15%), plus 0.3 to 1 px edges at 0.5 m |
| `echo_m` | 0.015 | 0.1 | m | BatMapper: 1 to 2 cm at p80 indoors to 3.5 m; 10 cm assumed outdoors |
| `probe_m` | 0.005 | 0.03 | m | tracking error while the camera faces the wall at contact, assumed; device geometry adds about 1 mm |
